abstract: Cytotrophoblasts (from term placentae) and cells from the choriocarcinoma cell line JAr were cultivated either separately or in co-culture for 72 h. RNA was isolated from the cell cultures and Northern blots were developed using equal amounts of RNA. The RNA was hybridized with cDNA probes for CG alpha, CG beta and hPL. Corresponding m-RNAs were detected in the three RNAs except for hPL m-RNA which was absent from JAr cells RNA. The abundance of CG alpha and CG beta m-RNA in the RNA of the co-culture was higher than their accumulative abundances in the RNAs from cytotrophoblasts and JAr cells cultured alone and the abundance of hPL m-RNA in the RNA of the co-cultures was as high as that in the RNA from cytotrophoblasts cultured alone. On the basis of previous findings (Hochberg et al, 1991), it can be assumed that the cytotrophoblasts in the co-cultures are responsible for the increase in hormonal m-RNA production. It could be calculated that the abundances of the CG alpha, CG beta and hPL m-RNAs in the RNA which originated in the cytotrophoblast nuclei were 20, 100 and 10-fold higher respectively in the co-culture compared to those in the culture of cytotrophoblasts. This effect is limited to certain genes only as the concentration of the 92kD collagenase m-RNA and uPA (urokinase type plasminogen activator) m-RNA, which are both produced in cytotrophoblasts to a much higher extent than in JAr cells, and are not increased by cultivating the cytotrophoblasts with JAr cells in co-culture.(ABSTRACT TRUNCATED AT 250 WORDS)
abstract_ja: 満期胎盤由来の細胞性栄養膜細胞と絨毛癌細胞株JArを、単独または共培養で72時間培養した。細胞からRNAを抽出し、CGα、CGβ、hPLのcDNAプローブを用いてノーザンブロットを行った。共培養では、CGαおよびCGβのmRNA量が、単独培養した細胞性栄養膜細胞およびJAr細胞のmRNA量の合計より高かった。hPL mRNAは、共培養時に細胞性栄養膜細胞単独培養と同程度に維持された。細胞性栄養膜細胞の核由来のRNAにおける各mRNAの存在量は、単独培養と比べて共培養でCGα、CGβ、hPLでそれぞれ20倍、100倍、10倍高かった。この効果は特定の遺伝子に限られ、細胞性栄養膜細胞でより多く産生される92kDコラゲナーゼおよびuPAのmRNAは、共培養による増加が認められなかった。
